story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Jaime Mendes has been working with furniture since the age of 12. It all began in his grandfather's family business, which passed on a passion for wood and carpentry — working with wood is making art, transforming what people imagine into something real and tangible.
story.paragraph2: The <brand>J. Mendes Mobiliário</brand> was born from a personal pursuit: a 50m² space, a panel saw and a copying machine, where most of the work was done by hand. With modest means, but the same essence and honesty that defines us to this day, we kept growing.
story.paragraph3: Today our furniture factory is equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and a team of young craftspeople trained by the founder himself — to whom he passed on not just technical knowledge, but a genuine love for carpentry.
story.imageAlt1: Image from the history of J. Mendes Furniture
story.imageAlt2: Image of the J. Mendes Furniture team
story.paragraph4: Focused on all types of furniture — from residential projects to collaborations with architects — we continue to bring the dreams of those who seek us to life.
